ctaHeading: Wyndham Vale Gardeners Ready to Help
aboutText: OZY GREEN offers professional garden and yard maintenance services in Wyndham Vale and the wider western suburbs of Melbourne. Our team handles everything from lawn mowing to tree removal, ensuring your outdoor space looks its best. We are available 7 days a week, providing timely and affordable solutions for all your gardening needs.
servicesText: At OZY GREEN, we cover all aspects of garden care, including lawn maintenance, hedge trimming, and turf installation. Our services are designed to keep your property looking pristine throughout the seasons.

services.title: Lawn Care
services.desc: Professional lawn mowing, edging, and maintenance to keep your grass healthy and neat.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular gardening, weed control, and pruning to maintain beautiful garden beds.

services.title: Tree & Hedge Services
services.desc: Expert hedge trimming, tree removal, and chainsaw work for safety and aesthetics.

services.title: Turf Installation
services.desc: Installation of natural turf and synthetic grass for lush, durable lawns.

services.title: Cleaning Services
services.desc: Thorough gutter cleaning, pressure washing, and rubbish removal for a spotless exterior.

services.title: Yard Cleanups
services.desc: Comprehensive yard clean-ups, including end-of-lease services for real estate properties.
